name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted paste bin, file sharing and URL shortener with expiring uploads, raw links, QR codes and optional end-to-end encryption.

alerts.message: Anyone who can reach the URL can upload. The admin panel at /admin signs in as admin with the generated MICROBIN_ADMIN_PASSWORD. To restrict uploads, add MICROBIN_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME and MICROBIN_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD (or MICROBIN_READONLY and MICROBIN_UPLOADER_PASSWORD) to the service environment.
